programme.title: Ngwana Wa Tshwenya
programme.desc: 'S2/E7 - Akani'. At 9yo, Akani is suspended from school for bullying, hitting other kids, & crossing serious boundaries.

programme.title: Tseleng
programme.desc: 'S3/E8 - James & Lebo'. Baba James seeks Naledi's guidance in navigating life's moral complexities.

programme.title: Sugar Mamas Jhb
programme.desc: 'S3/E3 - Thabiso Is Concerned'. As Kukie visits Noko's family to build unity, Fumani confronts Tshepo for mistreating Thabiso, forcing Tshepo to face his faults and the cracks in their relationship.

programme.title: Councillor Tsotsi
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. A gritty investigative series following a councillor exposing corruption and injustice while amplifying community voices in the fight for truth and accountability.

programme.title: Fake Gobela
programme.desc: 'S4/E8 - Kgothatso'. Kgothatso and Nthabiseng went to Twasa at the same Gobela, instead of growing there gift they got scammed with a bakkie and 12 Savannah

programme.title: X-Repo
programme.desc: 'S7/E6'. Step inside the fast paced world where the X Repo team helps people reclaim what is rightfully theirs from cars and trucks to furniture and more.

programme.title: Vimba
programme.desc: 'S2/E10'. Vimba, meaning 'Stop' in English, is a crime investigation show that tackles lawless syndicates and criminal activities, aiming to clean up our streets.

programme.title: Sizok'thola
programme.desc: 'S5/E10 - Family business'. Crime devastates South African communities. Sizokuthola investigates cases, tracks criminals with law enforcement, ensuring offenders are brought to justice.

programme.title: You Promised To Marry Me
programme.desc: 'S4/E6 - Ntombikayise'. You promised to marry me, is about the people who feel betrayed by their partners to honour or fulfil their promise of marrying them.

programme.title: Thokoza Gogo
programme.desc: 'S1/E13'. Thokoza is a reality show that follows the life of a popular Sangoma, 'Maweni' who is also an ambitious entrepreneur, as she juggles motherhood, marriage and her personal life.

programme.title: Ishushu
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Neo & Gugu'. Neo and Gugu run their own fast food Business, but who can cook between the two? They battle it out on the Ishushu Kitchen so that they can put the matter to rest

programme.title: Uyaphuza
programme.desc: 'S3/E7 - Paris/Donavan'. An intervention show helping families affected by alcohol addiction. A platform for loved ones to find relief and get the help they need.

programme.title: Hope
